key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the menu

key.name: actions
key.description: Known actions: lock-screen, logout, suspend, switch-user, restart, power-off.

key.name: layout
key.description: "auto" picks the arrangement from the number of buttons (1-3 in a row, 4 as 2x2, 5 like a die face, 6 as 2x3); "grid" uses a fixed number of columns.

key.name: columns
key.summary: Number of buttons per row in the grid layout

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the buttons in pixels

key.name: show-labels
key.summary: Show the action name below the icon

key.name: confirm-mode
key.description: "none" runs every action at once, "all" asks for every action, "custom" asks only for the actions in confirm-list.

key.name: confirm-list
key.summary: Actions that ask for confirmation when confirm-mode is "custom"

key.name: confirm-timeout
key.summary: Seconds before a confirmation runs the action on its own

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show a button in the top bar
